title: Resume retry after a durability hold also fires for a head acknowledged before the Resume
outcome: Resume retry after a durability hold also fires for a head acknowledged before the Resume
acceptance: unstarted_resume_step retries a Resume's drain only when the new head's durability acknowledgement landed during that Resume (the head was unacknowledged at the Resume's first check), and a test shows that an earlier-acknowledged head exposed by a Cancel keeps the drain's ordinary outcome
